review_rule: Must be hash-pinned, exactly 4096 bytes, self-reproducing from committed text, and manually auditable.
Must be disclosed with OS/build version; it may execute chain output but not translate source.

examples: pinned macOS SDK headers and libraries
review_rule: Must be a declared Nix input or recorded system SDK and may only supply the documented target ABI.
Every invocation and input class must be logged; no source-language compilation is permitted.
May schedule and move data but must not decide or emit program semantics beyond a documented bootstrap exception.
May drive an allowed object-only link only when the trace proves there was no source input; otherwise it invalidates the faithful-chain claim.
May report or perform non-semantic orchestration; source, generated-code, symbol-selection, or linker-input transformations must be chain-built.
All fetched bytes must have a cryptographic content hash and recorded origin before use.
Must be produced by an earlier declared stage with matching compiler, flags, headers, target, and configuration.
